summary: Cover the disabled jobs admission boundary with corruption, snapshot, origin, concurrency and replay refusal fixtures.

replay.detail: Test-only replay runs without database tables and returns HistoryOnly from immutable signed content, proving it does not read membership, binding, host state or wall-clock state.

schema.detail: Fixtures distinguish unavailable membership/binding lookups and malformed rows from successfully proven absence. No production schema or migration is installed.

rules.detail: Real cryptographic signature corruption, nonce tampering, partial signatures, changed immutable binding fields, changed root, stale membership, binding conflicts and origin mismatches refuse. A step lease without a signature refuses.

compatibility.detail: Concurrent incompatible same-ID attempts both refuse while post-sealing proof is unavailable: zero grants, not a simulated successful grant. Tests do not claim authenticated admission or successful binding reservation.

downtime.detail: Tests only; no production caller, registration or activation.

manual.detail: No operator action. Rust tests were not executed in this assignment.

recovery.detail: No recovery execution or replay trigger is added.
